info.name: SPA Management API
info.description:
Postman collection for the SPA booking platform API (v1). Responses use `{ success, message, data }`; errors use `{ success:false, message, code, errors? }`. Set base_url to the API root including /api/v1.

Auth uses Register -> Verify registration -> Complete registration. Auth requests include saved response examples and scripts that capture verification_id, registration_token, access_token, refresh_token, reset_id and reset_token. See the Auth folder for workflow details.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
All 12 auth endpoints from routes/api/auth.php, with JSON payloads and saved success/error examples matching the current backend. Example IDs and tokens are illustrative.

Set base_url to your API root including /api/v1, without a trailing slash. Start with a mobile_number that is not already registered. The default server address is editable.

Registration: Register -> Verify registration -> Complete registration. Register captures verification_id; enter the SMS code in otp_code. Local/testing defaults to 1234 unless configured otherwise. Verification captures a single-use registration_token, valid for 600 seconds; it is never used as Bearer authentication. Completion captures access_token and refresh_token. Optional referral_code defaults to blank; supply a valid code to attach a referral. Invalid referrals reject completion without creating an account.

Resend requests are optional: wait at least 60 seconds before using them, then verify using the newly captured ID. All public auth routes share a limit of 10 requests/minute per IP. Do not run every request sequentially as a single workflow: resends, registration, login, recovery and logout are separate actions.

Login uses the current mobile_number/password and requires an active, mobile-verified account. Refresh rotates both captured tokens. Password change and logout use Bearer access_token. Password change/reset update the password variable to new_password on success; login again afterward. Logout clears the captured session tokens.

Password recovery: Forgot password -> Verify password reset code -> Reset password. Each step captures reset_id/reset_token. A successful forgot-password response can contain null reset_id when no account exists. The backend currently returns expires_in=600 for reset verification, while the persisted reset token uses the configured refresh-session lifetime. Recovery code issuance currently uses the configured static code and does not dispatch the SMS job; set otp_code accordingly for this flow.

Saved responses are examples, not evidence of live SMS delivery. Scripts capture variables only after a successful response.

Complete admin route collection from routes/api/admin.php. All requests use Bearer access_token and Accept: application/json. Parameter verification: every query/body field below was checked against its controller/request validation. Successful JSON responses use {success:boolean,message:string,data:...}. Paginated list endpoints return data:{items:[...],pagination:{page,per_page,total,total_pages,has_more}}. Categories return data:{items:[...]}; report endpoints return data objects with items or named aggregates as described by their controller. Document downloads return a private streamed file, not a JSON envelope. Collection examples show response envelope and data container shape; resource item fields are defined by the backend API Resources. Admin routes require admin.dashboard.view plus each module permission. Business onboarding and KYC document routes are included as private streamed downloads. Separate GET /admin/admin-users and GET /admin/customers directories accept created_from, created_to, status, signup_from, q, per_page, and page. Business listing supports the same date/source filters plus business status, verification, and online filters.
